title: Diploma core stream correlation rules
notes: Small operational pack for thesis scenarios that must be demonstrated explicitly.
Rules use enriched normalized fields and conservative thresholds to reduce false positives.
Rules are published into siem.correlation_rules_stream and executed by the stream correlation worker.

stream_rules.title: Threat Intel IOC Match On Enriched Event
stream_rules.description: Creates an incident when a normalized event already contains a threat-intelligence indicator.
stream_rules.expr: ((ti_indicator != '' or threat.indicator != '')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:'
stream_rules.operator_action: Open the event, confirm the indicator source and affected host, then pivot to related events by host and indicator.

stream_rules.title: Repeated IOC Destination
stream_rules.description: Detects repeated connections or events involving the same suspicious destination with IOC context.
stream_rules.expr: ((ti_indicator != '' and (destination.ip != '' or destination.domain != ''))) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:'
stream_rules.operator_action: Check whether the host repeatedly reaches an IOC-backed destination and isolate the host if the traffic is not approved.

stream_rules.title: Network Port Scan Burst
stream_rules.description: Detects repeated blocked firewall or scan events from the same source address.
stream_rules.expr: (((event.type == 'linux_firewall_blocked' or event.type == 'network_scan') and source.ip != '')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:'
stream_rules.operator_action: Review target ports, source address and affected hosts; keep as incident only when the burst is not expected internet background noise.

stream_rules.title: Suspicious Windows LOLBin Process Burst
stream_rules.description: Detects repeated Windows process creation events for common living-off-the-land binaries.
stream_rules.expr: ((event.type == 'windows_process_create' and (process.name icontains 'rundll32' or process.name icontains 'regsvr32' or process.name icontains 'mshta' or process.name icontains 'wmic'))) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:'
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect parent process, command line and user context; compare with administrative software allowlists.

stream_rules.title: Repeated Non-Informational Network Destination
stream_rules.description: Detects repeated medium-or-higher network events to the same destination.
stream_rules.expr: (((event.category == 'network' and destination.ip != '') and event.severity != 'info')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:'
stream_rules.operator_action: Check if repeated non-informational network activity to the destination is expected; pivot to host and destination timeline.

stream_rules.title: Protected Public IP Probe Burst
stream_rules.description: Detects repeated network or firewall activity toward protected public SIEM/VPN addresses.
stream_rules.expr: (((destination.ip == '176.108.250.215' or destination.ip == '45.89.111.208') and source.ip != '' and (event.category == 'network' or event.type == 'linux_firewall_blocked' or event.type == 'network_scan'))) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:'
stream_rules.operator_action: Pivot to Attack geography and IP detail, confirm target ports, then add the source to TI/deny list only after validating it is not expected monitoring.

stream_rules.title: Protected Public SSH Spray
stream_rules.description: Detects SSH/authentication failures against protected public addresses.
stream_rules.expr: (((destination.ip == '176.108.250.215' or destination.ip == '45.89.111.208') and source.ip != '' and (destination.port == '22' or event.type icontains 'ssh' or event.category == 'authentication'))) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:'
stream_rules.operator_action: Check whether the source is spraying SSH or auth endpoints, review related failures, and escalate if the address also appears in GeoIP/TI context.
